positions.title: Assistant Research Biostatistician
positions.description: Under the mentorship of senior statisticians, I consulted with physician investigators in study design and analysis plans. After implementing these plans, I regularly produced, summarized, and reported the results of statistical analysis progress. At the time of manuscript development, I contributed statistical write-ups and publication-ready plots to study methodology and results sections. Finally, I provided ad-hoc consultation and support to research staff when needed.
positions.insights: Skills: R · Data Visualization · Data Engineering · SAS

positions.title: Research Analyst
positions.description: Following an 11-week internship in the summer of 2015, I continued at ChildObesity180 as a Graduate Research Assistant from September 2015 to May 2016 and as a Research Data Analyst from June 2016 to July 2017. I designed data entry systems in REDCap, Qualtrics, SPSS Author, and Microsoft excel and coordinated data entry personnel with other members of the Research and Evaluation team. Following the completion of data entry, I collaboratively developed SAS and R code for reproducible data management, cleaning, and merging with relational data from internal and external sources. Throughout the data cleaning and management, I drafted dataset documentation for analysis. When requested, I provided varied support to organizational initiatives--I compiled regular summary reports, assisted in research study implementation and data collection, and developed web modules for the New Balance Foundation Billion Mile Race.

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description: Assisting the Curriculum Coordinator of the Biostatistics department, I: documented and reported BU Biostatistics Ph.D. and M.A. candidate degree progress, collected, organized, and prepared Ph.D., M.A., and summer program applications, and regularly updated departmental website and designed flyers for department events.

publications.title: Emotion regulation therapy for cancer caregivers-an open trial of a mechanism-targeted approach to addressing caregiver distress.
